description: This file contains functions for decrypting backup files, including handling different backup file types, decrypting with or without items keys, and selecting appropriate keys for decryption. It is part of a cryptography or encryption module within a larger project.

methods.name: DecryptBackupFile

methods.name: getBackupFileType
methods.description: Determines the type of backup file based on its contents and associated payloads.

methods.name: decryptEncryptedWithNonEncryptedItemsKey
methods.description: Decrypts payloads when the backup file contains encrypted items with non-encrypted items keys.

methods.name: findKeyToUseForPayload
methods.description: Selects the appropriate encryption key for a given payload based on available keys and key parameters.

methods.name: decryptWithItemsKeys
methods.description: Decrypts payloads using a list of items keys, handling both root key and items key decryption.

methods.name: decryptEncrypted
